answer: Ephemeral challenge escrow. Each identity must answer a fresh, unannounced challenge whose correct response depends on a secret seeded per round and revealed only after submission, so prior answers cannot be copied. Answers are checked in a meadow of parallel evaluators, and payout clears only if timing and entropy match. A nebula of rotating secrets prevents precomputation, while any duplicate response falls into a canyon of rejection. Attackers pay per attempt: compute, latency, and lost escrow on every failed clone.
